children: Beam Global (BEEM) filed a Form 8K - Director, Officer or Compensation Filing - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 24, 2026.

On September 21, 2026, the Board of Directors of Beam Global (the "Company") approved stock awards under the Company's 2021 Equity Incentive Plan of 250,000 shares of common stock to Desmond Wheatley, the Company's President and Chief Executive Officer, and 90,000 shares of common stock to Lisa A. Potok, the Company's Chief Financial Officer. The awards were approved as bonus compensation in recognition of their services and performance during fiscal year 2025.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1398805/000143774926031143/beem20260923_8k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1398805/000143774926031143/0001437749-26-031143-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
